preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= wi <= 50 for _, _, wi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a length between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The starting vertex s of the policeman is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of criminals m is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xj <= n and xj != s for xj in criminals)
preconditions.description: Each criminal is located at a vertex between 1 and n inclusive, and not at the starting vertex s.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Terrorists win' or a non-negative integer representing the time needed to catch all criminals.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'Terrorists win' or all(any(xj in path for xj in criminals) for path in all_paths(s, criminals))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Terrorists win', there is no path from the policeman to all criminals.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Terrorists win' or int(stdout) == min(max(sum(edge_lengths(path)) for path in all_paths(s, criminals)) for criminals in permutations(criminals))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Terrorists win', it is the minimum time required for the policeman to catch all criminals, considering all permutations of criminal paths.
